title: config/cron.yaml (parsed)
description: The schedule the Nornir scheduler (bin/time/nornir-cron-start.sh) actually runs (plan 58, Phase 7). cron.yaml is a LINE format — `<shape> [@role[,role]] <command>`, either order, where <shape> is HH:MM · @daily · @hourly · @hourly:MM · @every:N, optionally preceded by a day gate (Mon · Tue,Fri) — so the loader parses each live line into this document and validates THAT, because a line the scheduler cannot parse is a job that silently never fires. The role gate is the fleet's role law: heart · forge · dev · hand.

time.description: the schedule shape: HH:MM (once a day, matched to the minute) · @daily (00:00 once a day) · @hourly (the top of every hour) · @hourly:MM (that minute of every hour) · @every:N (every N minutes, aligned to the hour). The shape decides both the match and the stamp key, so a per-day row cannot fire twice a day and a per-hour row cannot fire twice an hour (plan 140).

command.description: the command line the scheduler runs (bash -lc)

roles.description: the role gate (@heart,@forge); empty means any role

day.description: the DAY gate (plan 305): the weekdays a row fires on, written before the shape — `@heart Mon 09:15 bin/mail/draft-age.sh --weekly`, or `Tue,Fri 09:15 …` with no role gate. Omitted means every day. A day the scheduler cannot read is named in state/.cron-invalid and never fires, so a weekly row cannot look scheduled while being dead.
